title: Evidence for one application's login
description: tests/fixtures/logins/<id>/evidence.json: where every login selector of one application came from, what was built from it, and what is not known. This schema covers structure and bounds. tests/tooling/loginFixtureCorpus.node-test.mjs is authoritative and additionally requires: id equal to the directory name and to a catalog profile (or proposedProfile); real dates, none in the future, no source retrieved after the review; unique source ids; source equal to the citation of a listed source; every selector and fixture citing listed sources; class A only when every selector is observed in an authoritative source; an observed selector that matches its cited capture, or whose ids and field names occur in its cited repository file; cited repository paths that exist and lie outside this corpus and the steps data; public sources pinned to a commit or release, never a moving branch; captures that exist, match their hash and, when anonymous, were made from the application's own hostedLoginUrl; fixture files that exist, are listed, are synthetic and are matched by their selectors; nothing resembling a credential or a private address; and agreement with the application's steps file in src/data/loginSteps when there is one.

proposedProfile.description: Set only for an application that is not in the catalog yet.

class.description: A: every selector was observed in an authoritative source. B: at least one selector is inferred or comes from a public page captured anonymously or from secondary material; an informed guess until the user confirms it. C: nothing to build from; no selectors, no fixture, no steps.

mechanism.description: form: a page form filled through selectors. adapter: a dedicated in-repository staged adapter (catalog loginFlow). http-auth: HTTP Basic or Digest, no page. none: class C.

source.description: The primary citation: the url, path or capture of one entry of sources. The steps file's evidence.source repeats it.

reviewed.description: The date of this review. The steps file's evidence.reviewed repeats it.

staysInteractive.description: What the user still does by hand. An empty list states that nothing is known to interrupt the login.

unverified.description: Class B only: each thing that was not observed, for example the step after the identifier, or other firmware versions.

lookedFor.description: Class C: what was examined and what it showed.

neededFromUser.description: Class B and C: what would turn this into class A.

schemaGaps.description: Anything about this login that the steps format could not express.

applicationId.description: Application profile id; equal to the directory name.

httpsUrl.description: An https URL with no user information.

repositoryPath.description: A path with forward slashes, relative to the root of the repository the source names.

selectorText.description: A CSS selector, with the bounds of the steps format.

origin.description: An exact HTTPS origin of a public DNS name, as in the steps format: the same pattern as $defs.origin of src/types/connection/httpLoginSteps.schema.json, which refuses IP literals, single-label hosts and special-use or private-use suffixes.

kind.description: Authoritative, able to support class A: repository (a fixture, adapter or test in this repository), public-source (the application's own published source at a commit or release), cdp-auth (the user's cdp-auth tool at a commit), user-capture (a page the user saved, read with --from-file), user-confirmation (the user signed in with this layout). Not authoritative, class B only: anonymous-capture (a public hosted page rendered once without an account), vendor-documentation, secondary. Recollection is not a source and has no kind.

retrieved.description: The date the source was read, captured or confirmed.

capture.description: The capture file in this directory, or in a sibling application's directory when both share one hostedLoginUrl.

captureSha256.description: The captureSha256 the capture tool printed: the hash of the capture's canonical JSON.

role.description: control: a clicked pre-step or submit control.

basis.description: observed: the attributes the selector relies on are present in the cited source. inferred: not seen there; worked out from it.

locator.description: Where in the source the element is: a line range, or the element's id in a capture.

fixture.description: The fixture document the selector must match. Without it, any fixture of the directory.

origin.description: The origin this document is served on. Omit it for the connection's own origin, as in the steps format.

path.description: The pathname this document is served on.

frame.description: Set when this document is the content of that same-origin child frame of the top fixture.
